evals.prompt: Loop on CI for the current branch's PR: inspect `gh pr checks`, diagnose the failing job, apply a minimal fix without bypassing hooks, and tell me the status.
evals.expected_output: Uses `gh pr checks --json name,bucket,state,workflow,link` as the source of truth, inspects the failed run logs via `gh run view --log-failed` or the external check link, applies a minimal scoped fix, and reports CI status.
expectations: Uses `gh pr checks` as the source of truth for PR-attached checks rather than relying solely on `gh run list`.
Inspects failing job logs (`gh run view <run-id> --log-failed`) or external check links before editing.
Scopes the fix to a single actionable failure cause and does not use `--no-verify`.
Reports the primary failing job, fixes applied, and current CI status.

evals.prompt: PR checks are still pending on my branch; use ci-loop to watch them fail-fast and diagnose any failure that appears.
evals.expected_output: Checks current PR check state first, watches pending checks with `gh pr checks --watch --fail-fast`, and diagnoses any failure or reports green status.
expectations: Inspects current PR checks before starting a watch.
Uses `gh pr checks --watch --fail-fast` for pending checks.
Distinguishes PR-caused failures from unrelated main branch failures or flakes.

evals.prompt: Fix CI on this PR: one external Vercel preview check failed and one GitHub Actions unit test job failed.
evals.expected_output: Inspects both the GitHub Actions failure log and the external check link from `gh pr checks`, fixes one actionable root error at a time, and re-checks the full PR check set.
expectations: Reads `gh pr checks --json name,bucket,state,workflow,link` to see both GitHub Actions and external checks.
Fixes one actionable root error at a time with minimal changes.
Re-evaluates the full PR check set after changes.
